STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast plate (scrambled eggs, bacon, sausage links, breakfast potatoes, strawberries, sautéed spinach/greens with shredded carrot). Photographed from above, roughly top-down with slight perspective distortion.

STEP 2 - Ruler: White square plate, roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 530 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: scrambled eggs, bacon (about 4-5 strips), pork sausage links (about 3), breakfast potatoes (about 5 cubes), strawberries (about 3 halves), sautéed spinach/leafy greens, shredded carrot. No visible oil pool beyond light cooking sheen.

STEP 4 - Area (share of plate covered):
- Scrambled eggs 22% (~117 cm²)
- Bacon 12% (~64 cm²)
- Sausage 10% (~53 cm²)
- Potatoes 8% (~42 cm²)
- Strawberries 6% (~32 cm²)
- Spinach/greens 12% (~64 cm²)
- Carrot 2% (~11 cm²)
Total ≈ 72% of plate covered.

STEP 5 - Volume (area × height):
- Eggs: 117 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 175 ml
- Bacon: 64 cm² × 0.4 cm ≈ 26 ml
- Sausage: 53 cm² × 1.8 cm ≈ 95 ml
- Potatoes: 42 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 84 ml
- Strawberries: 32 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 48 ml
- Spinach: 64 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 96 ml
- Carrot: 11 cm² × 0.5 cm ≈ 6 ml

STEP 6 - Grams (bulk density):
- Eggs: 175 × 0.9 ≈ 158 g

- Potatoes: 84 × 0.7 ≈ 59 g (cooked cubes, dense)

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Eggs (scrambled, cooked): 158 g × 150 kcal/100g ≈ 237 kcal
- Bacon (cooked): 23 g × 540 ≈ 124 kcal
- Sausage (pork, cooked): 86 g × 300 ≈ 258 kcal
- Potatoes (pan-fried): 59 g × 150 ≈ 89 kcal
- Strawberries: 29 g × 32 ≈ 9 kcal
- Spinach (sautéed): 14 g × 25 ≈ 4 kcal
- Carrot: 4 g × 41 ≈ 2 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total ≈ 364 g, ≈ 723 kcal. This is plausible for a full breakfast plate covering about three-quarters of a dinner plate.
